description: Security group ingress rule added. Overly permissive rules (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0) expose resources to the internet.
playbook: The specific CIDR-based rule that was added has been automatically revoked (IPv6 ranges, prefix lists, and security-group-reference sources are not auto-revoked -- review those manually in the EC2 console). Confirm the revocation in CloudTrail/VPC Flow Logs, and check whether the source CIDR (0.0.0.0/0, ::/0) or port (22, 3389, 5432, 3306, etc) indicates this was a deliberate attack rather than a misconfiguration before re-authorizing anything.
